0022600205.text: The Washington Wizards, now 4-6 and eighth in the East, head to Detroit for their 11th game of the season, having lost three straight and sitting 2.5 games back of the top spot in the Southeast, while the Pistons, at 6-2 and first in the Central, have lost their most recent game. Washington is missing Anthony Davis (ankle sprain), Deandre Ayton (leg), Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), and Detroit is without Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Wizards lost the season series 1-3, including a 117-95 loss in Washington on March 19.
